messages.author: 95cf8335759afb7b
messages.subject: Use truncated values from Skyline
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am new to this group and I hope that I am not about to ask something that has already been discussed before. Is it correct that there is at the moment no easy way to use quantitative features from Skyline in MSstats that have been flagged as truncated by Skyline? I believe SkylinetoMSstatsFormat would turn those to NA?

Thank you,
Roman

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: Use truncated values from Skyline
parts:
Hi,


if you want to keep these rows, you will need to use the extended workflow from MSstatsConvert package and replace our MSstatsClean method for Skyline files with your own code that doesn't filter by Truncated column. You can do that by adjusting the code from converters.R file from MSstats package and .cleanSkyline function from MSstatsConvert package. Currently, keeping Truncated rows is not a option in ou converter.


Kind regards,
Mateusz
